scope: Apply once to BOTH original Qwen3.5-9B base58 and same-prompt epoch2 adapter58 only after both raw outputs freeze; keep both original primary predictions unchanged.

policy.name: exact-patient-evidence-wrapper-v1
policy.patient_id: Exact supplied string ID; unique within this candidate list.
policy.evidence: String, retained verbatim in raw and audit; not checked for clinical correctness.
policy.eligible_value: Nonempty list entirely of exact two-field objects; no mixed values.
policy.scope: Only expected CID keys already present in a strict JSON object.
policy.reject_row: Token limit, non-strict JSON, duplicate JSON keys, non-object top level.
policy.unmodified: Missing/unknown CID or HPA keys, unknown/duplicate IDs, additional fields, non-string fields, mixed/scalar values, and all originally valid lists.
policy.application: Independent paired base/adapter control; never replace original primary parsing.

output_identity_validation: Unique row_id, exact row_id-to-pmc_id map; output order need not equal prompt order.
output_provenance: Input responses SHA and originating runner manifest prompt/output SHA both required. Modified response file is separate; sidecar stores exact original text and projected values; restore equality checked for every row. Generation token/time metadata remains original metadata.
command_template: python solutions/case_retrieval/normalize_pair_schema.py --prompts ORIGINAL58_PROMPTS --responses FROZEN_RAW_RESPONSES --runner-manifest FROZEN_RUNNER_MANIFEST --output NEW_CONTROL_RESPONSES.jsonl; then use the same frozen original merge script, entities, fallback and evaluator under a new control output path.
